assumptions.statement: The artifact bundle is a planning/specification bundle, not production code.
assumptions.rationale: RUN_MODE was staged and non-goals prohibit production code unless requested.
assumptions.validation_method: User explicitly requests implementation or provides repository.

assumptions.statement: No actual repository is attached for code inspection.
assumptions.rationale: Conversation contains prompt/design files but no repo tree.
assumptions.risk_if_wrong: Repo-specific commands and paths may be omitted.
assumptions.validation_method: Provide GitHub repo or uploaded source tree.

assumptions.statement: OpenAPI or equivalent should be the contract source of truth.
assumptions.rationale: Architecture target names OpenAPI as shared contract/intermediate representation.

assumptions.statement: SSE is the default streaming protocol unless bidirectional transport is required.
assumptions.rationale: Prompt emphasizes SSE/resumable streaming and live status.
assumptions.validation_method: Check implementation needs and hosting runtime.

assumptions.statement: Durable Objects coordinate bounded per-run state rather than storing canonical graph state or large artifacts.
assumptions.rationale: Sharding and anti-bottleneck constraints require DOs not be global state stores.
assumptions.risk_if_wrong: Over-sharding or under-sharding could impair runtime operations.
assumptions.validation_method: Load test and review Cloudflare limits.
